gap_records.claim: The win position cannot be checked against an exposed goal x, because the frozen observable contract exposes no goal entity or goal x value.
gap_records.player_impact: A tester can see that won flips to true while grounded, but cannot prove the goal sits on the walkable ground path from the contract alone; a goal placed off the path would look identical in the records.
gap_records.recommended_update: Keep the goal on the walkable ground path and keep re-citing the grounded win sample (raw/e3_win_position.json); if a real goal x is required later, raise a decision and re-freeze the hash rather than adding an unreflected marker.

gap_records.claim: The plan's priority-1 requirement for a persisted .hoh/deterministic/raw/ late-round liveness step (a bevy_health plus bevy_player_transform read several seconds after the E3 steps) is not satisfied by the battery: no such step exists in battery.json or under deterministic/raw/.
gap_records.player_impact: A mid-round exit or freeze could previously only be shown from non-persisted calls; the deterministic battery alone still cannot refute a late-round hang.
gap_records.recommended_update: Add one deterministic battery step that runs after the E3 steps and persists a bevy_health and bevy_player_transform reply, with the frame field taken from hof_game::contract::FrameCounter, into .hoh/deterministic/raw/.

preservation_constraints: Crate name hof_game and module hof_game::contract stay frozen; type paths Player, Grounded, FrameCounter, CoinCounter, WinFlag, InputIntent, ProcessNonce and the registered bevy_transform::components::transform::Transform must not be renamed or re-registered.
RemotePlugin::default() + RemoteHttpPlugin::default() + ScheduleRunnerPlugin with the headless no-window/no-GPU switch must stay, so http://127.0.0.1:15702/ binds and the process keeps answering.
InputIntent stays level-triggered with the game clearing it each frame; every reading's frame field stays sourced from FrameCounter.

Verified iteration-3 behaviour must stay green: dir=1 raises x, dir=-1 lowers it, dir=0 freezes x byte-identically; coins 0 -> 1 -> 2 monotone non-decreasing; won false -> true one-way; jump rises then falls back to the on-ground y with Grounded true before take-off and false mid-flight.
update_targets: Add the missing persisted late-round liveness battery step (gap S1-deterministic-step) that reads bevy_health and bevy_player_transform after the E3 steps.
Keep the goal reachable by walking right on the ground path until a goal-x contract decision is made (gap P3-goal-x).
validation_requirements: Re-run the whole battery in one fresh headless session and require ok=true for e3_movement, e3_movement_left, e3_movement_release, e3_jump_arc, e3_grounded, e3_grounded_payload, e3_coin_counter, e3_win_flag, e3_win_position.
In that same session require coins 0 before any pickup then a positive value (and 2 after the second pickup) monotone non-decreasing on every later read.
In that same session require won false before the goal and true afterwards with Grounded.on_ground true at the sampled translation.x, staying true on every later read.
Require the new late liveness step's persisted raw record to answer after the E3 steps with a frame value coming from FrameCounter.
